about_the_game:
One day, a group of bandits attacked Damaira, the village where the princess and her loyal mouse guardian, Arlo lived. In defending their home, they uncovered the first threads of a greater darkness, the Forsakens spreading across the land of Fenua. What begins as a small skirmish soon leads to an adventure to uncover the truth of the Princess’s identity and the fate that awaits her and Arlo.

Princess Covenant is a hand-drawn pixel-art card-battler game infused with turn-based RPG mechanics. Each ally you recruit brings unique skills, and through the job-system (Vocations), you can evolve them into powerful new cards. Craft your deck, build strategies that complement your team’s strengths, and unleash synergies that turn the tide of battle. The game is designed to be approachable for newcomers, yet layered with enough challenge for genre veterans to master. It is a single-player game that has roguelike element in the rewards system, where your choice matters in deciding the result of your journey.

Features:

  • Upgrade and Evolve Vocations - Level up your battlers and upgrade their vocations to unlock powerful new abilities as you customize your strategy.

  • Recruit Over 50 Unique Battlers - Collect and command a roster of more than 50 battlers, each with distinct powers and playstyles.

  • Master Your Deck - Build and refine your deck with Humans, Beasts, Mythicals, and Forsakens - each with their own strengths and weaknesses to exploit in battle.

  • Accessible Yet Deep Combat - Draw cards, play your hand, and outwit foes in turn-based card battles that are easy-to-learn but challenging-to-master.

  • Fight Beside the Princess - Stand with Princess and her mouse guardian, Arlo, through a story-driven campaign of her destiny.

  • 7 x 2 Unique Dungeons - Conquer 7 different dungeons with two difficulty levels catered to guide your journey on Fenua.

  • Hand-drawn Pixel-Art - Experience hand-drawn pixel-art visuals that bring nostalgia back to life.

  • 5 Hours of Gameplay – Complete the main story in around 5 hours, with replayability ensuring no two runs are ever the same.
